# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import re
from collections import Counter

WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text``, ignoring case.

    A word is a maximal run of ASCII letters and apostrophes, so ``"don't"``
    counts as one word while ``"well-known"`` counts as two.

    Words are returned lowercased as ``(word, count)`` tuples, sorted by count
    descending and then alphabetically.
    """
    if k <= 0:
        return []
    counts = Counter(match.lower() for match in WORD_RE.findall(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
